text:
eli: Morning team, I'm Eli (eli@freelance-devs.co) starting today. I accepted the Okta invite but my Google Workspace alias (eli@redwood.dev) isn't linked, so Drive access is missing. 1Password shows "no seat" and SMS MFA codes never arrive (roaming). Can someone help with temporary access and an MFA workaround?

it-andy: Welcome Eli! Can you share a contact email for temp Drive share? We can also issue a short-lived 1Password guest link. For MFA, we can enable TOTP (Authy/Google Authenticator) or issue a temporary YubiKey if you prefer hardware. Which would you like?

eli: Thanks Andy. Use eli.personal@gmail.com for Drive. TOTP is fine — I'd rather not ship hardware.

provision-bot: INC-2680 created by it-andy: "New contractor: alias mapping + 1Password seat + MFA" priority P2.

devex: Sending a 48h 1Password guest vault link in DM now (please don't store long-term secrets). Also sharing onboarding Drive folder to eli.personal@gmail.com.

it-andy: Drive share invited. I've added eli@freelance-devs.co to the contractors-temp group so you have basic access while we fix the alias.

infra-liz: FYI the SCIM mapping for external domains didn't include freelance-devs.co -> redwood.dev alias. I'll add a scoped rule and trigger a user sync. ETA 4-6 hours.

eli: Guest 1Password link and Drive both work, thanks. Quick follow-up: how do I get repo access? I need SSH for the starter ticket.

it-andy: DM your GitHub handle and public SSH key and we'll grant the repo-team role. We can also invite by email if you prefer.

provision-bot: INC-2680 updated  infra-liz assigned; alias mapping planned. 1Password seat request forwarded to licensing.

eli: DM'd GitHub handle and key. Also, will the Okta->Google swap fix my MFA enrollment issues or do I keep using TOTP?

infra-liz: Once the alias mapping and SCIM sync complete we'll re-run the SSO sync. That should make eli@redwood.dev canonical and your Okta profile will show the right email; SMS delivery may improve but keep TOTP as primary for now.

devex: Noted — keep using the guest vault + TOTP until ticket INC-2680 is resolved. We'll extend any needed temporary access if fixes take longer.

eli: Appreciate it all. I'll proceed with the tasks and report back if anything breaks. :thumbsup:
